config.script:
# tile onClick: send a message and log.
	# messageHandler param may be:
	#   "myHandler"              -> scope='page' (default)
	#   "session:myHandler"      -> scope='session'
	#   "project:myHandler"      -> scope='project'
	#   "view:myHandler"         -> scope='view'
	
	handler = (self.view.params.inputs.messageHandler or '').strip()
	if not handler:
		system.perspective.print('Tile: No messageHandler provided; click ignored.')
		return
	
	# Parse optional "<scope>:<handler>" prefix
	parts = handler.split(':', 1)
	if len(parts) == 2:
		scope = parts[0].strip().lower()
		messageType = parts[1].strip()
	else:
		scope = 'page'
		messageType = handler
	
	if scope not in ('page', 'session', 'project', 'view'):
		system.perspective.print("Tile: Invalid scope '%s'; defaulting to 'page'." % scope)
		scope = 'page'
	
	# Minimal, helpful payload
	now = system.date.now()
	sessionInfo = system.perspective.getSessionInfo() or {}
	payload = {
		'label'   : self.view.params.label,
		'source'  : {'viewPath': self.view.path, 'pageId': system.perspective.getPageId(), 'sessionId': sessionInfo.get('id')},
		'timestamp': now,
		'epochMs' : system.date.toMillis(now)
		}
	
	system.perspective.print("Tile: sending message '%s' (scope=%s)" % (messageType, scope))
	try:
		system.perspective.sendMessage(messageType, payload, scope=scope)
		system.perspective.print("Tile: message '%s' sent." % messageType)
	except:
		system.perspective.print("Tile: sendMessage failed for '%s' (scope=%s)." % (messageType, scope))
